cond_0001.intro: The Banking Operations Systems Analyst is responsible for assisting bank staff with deep technical support, implementation, and maintenance on banking operations products and services. This critical operational support role for the Bank will act as a liaison between software and service providers, banking teams, and bank staff to promote clear communication across the organization, transparency on our products and services, and overall support for the TM business.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Acts as a technical and software product expert for banking operations products and systems, deeply understanding how our operations systems function, interact with one another and how to troubleshoot complex client issues.
Assists the Banking Operations teams with Jack Henry core banking problem resolution, investigating problems against previously understood issues and resolving as appropriate. If problem resolution requires vendor support, you will own the issue from start to finish, working with vendor and troubleshooting issue in tandem.
Develop, execute, and maintain automated processes for high volume tasks via standardized vendor supported tools such as Macros and RPA, including reporting functions for Banking Operations teams.
Continually supports all Banking Operations products and services, including primary interface with core service provider for deposit product related issues.
Identify and implement process and system function improvements.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3-4 Years of experience in Computer Science or Systems Management.
Experience implementing Robotic Process Automation (RPA) technology.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite applications.
Ability to communicate effectively with team members and external clients.
Can work well under pressure with the capability to always remain calm and courteous, especially when handling difficult calls and requests.
Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to offer recommendations and/or solutions to complex client inquiries/issues.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree.
Database management experience.
Ability to develop and maintain knowledge of Treasury Management products and services.

You will act as a liaison between software and service providers, banking teams, and bank staff, staying in regular contact across the organization to keep communication clear and products well-supported.
cond_0195.responsibilities:
Acts as a technical and software product expert for banking operations products and systems, regularly connecting with operations teams to explain how systems function, interact with one another, and how to troubleshoot complex client issues.
Works closely with the Banking Operations teams on Jack Henry core banking problem resolution, actively investigating problems against previously understood issues and resolving as appropriate. If problem resolution requires vendor support, you will own the issue from start to finish, staying in ongoing contact with the vendor and troubleshooting the issue in tandem.
Develop, execute, and maintain automated processes for high volume tasks via standardized vendor supported tools such as Macros and RPA, including reporting functions for Banking Operations teams.
Continually supports all Banking Operations products and services, including regular interface with the core service provider for deposit product related issues.
Identify and implement process and system function improvements, bringing people together to clarify needs and walk teams through proposed changes.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0195.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree preferred.
3-4 Years of experience in Computer Science or Systems Management.
Experience implementing Robotic Process Automation (RPA) technology.
Database management experience preferred.
Ability to develop and maintain knowledge of Treasury Management products and services.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite applications required.
Ability to communicate effectively and confidently with team members and external clients, including explaining trade-offs and handling questions clearly.
Can work well under pressure with the capability to always remain calm and courteous, especially when handling difficult calls and requests.
Comfortable working collaboratively within a team environment, actively contributing to discussions and raising issues early.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to offer recommendations and/or solutions to complex client inquiries/issues.
cond_0195.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0195.values: We value acting with integrity and keeping the interests of others in view. We aim to create positive outcomes through work that is respectful, fair, and responsible.

cond_0261.intro: The Banking Operations Systems Analyst works alongside bank staff to provide technical support, implementation, and maintenance for banking operations products and services. This role serves as a liaison between software and service providers, banking teams, and bank staff to support clear communication across the organization, transparency on products and services, and shared support for the TM business.
cond_0261.responsibilities:
Acts as a technical and software product expert for banking operations products and systems, working closely with teams to understand how operations systems function, interact with one another, and how to troubleshoot complex client issues.
Coordinates with Banking Operations teams on Jack Henry core banking problem resolution, investigating problems against previously understood issues and resolving as appropriate. If problem resolution requires vendor support, you will work with the vendor from start to finish, troubleshooting the issue in tandem.
Develop, execute, and maintain automated processes for high volume tasks via standardized vendor supported tools such as Macros and RPA, including reporting functions for Banking Operations teams.
Supports all Banking Operations products and services in coordination with the team, including serving as a primary point of contact with the core service provider for deposit product related issues.
Identify and help implement process and system function improvements in collaboration with relevant teams.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0261.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3-4 Years of experience in Computer Science or Systems Management.
Experience implementing Robotic Process Automation (RPA) technology.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite applications.
Ability to communicate effectively with team members and external clients.
Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to offer recommendations and/or solutions to complex client inquiries/issues.
Ability to remain calm and courteous under pressure, especially when handling difficult calls and requests.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's Degree.
Database management experience.
Ability to develop and maintain knowledge of Treasury Management products and services.

Acts as a technical and software product expert for banking operations products and systems, deeply understanding how our operations systems function, interact with one another and how to troubleshoot complex client issues.

Continually supports all Banking Operations products and services, including primary interface with core service provider for deposit product related issues.
Identify and implement process and system function improvements.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0353.requirements:
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 4 years of demonstrated expertise in Computer Science or Systems Management.
Proven track record implementing Robotic Process Automation (RPA) technology.
Substantial database management experience preferred.
Advanced knowledge of Treasury Management products and services.
Strong command of Microsoft Office Suite applications required.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with team members and external clients.
Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure, including when handling difficult calls and requests.
Strong leadership abilities within a collaborative team environment.
Deep problem-solving expertise with the ability to offer well-reasoned recommendations and solutions to complex client inquiries and issues.

cond_0392.intro: The Banking Operations Systems Analyst is responsible for assisting bank staff with deep technical support, implementation, and maintenance on banking operations products and services. This critical operational support role for the Bank will act as a liaison between software and service providers, banking teams, and bank staff to promote clear communication across the organization, transparency on our products and services, and overall support for the TM business. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with banking systems and operations support.
cond_0392.responsibilities:
Acts as a technical and software product expert for banking operations products and systems, deeply understanding how our operations systems function, interact with one another and how to troubleshoot complex client issues.
Assists the Banking Operations teams with Jack Henry core banking problem resolution, investigating problems against previously understood issues and resolving as appropriate. If problem resolution requires vendor support, you will own the issue from start to finish, working with vendor and troubleshooting issue in tandem.
Develop, execute, and maintain automated processes for high volume tasks via standardized vendor supported tools such as Macros and RPA, including reporting functions for Banking Operations teams.
Continually supports all Banking Operations products and services, including primary interface with core service provider for deposit product related issues.
Identify and implement process and system function improvements.
Other duties as assigned.
cond_0392.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree preferred.
3-4 Years of experience in Computer Science or Systems Management.
Experience implementing Robotic Process Automation (RPA) technology.
Database management experience preferred.
Ability to develop and maintain knowledge of Treasury Management products and services.
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite applications required.
Ability to communicate effectively with team members and external clients.
Can work well under pressure with the capability to always remain calm and courteous, especially when handling difficult calls and requests.
Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to offer recommendations and/or solutions to complex client inquires/issues.
